// starter code for loading and analyzing data using Python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the CSV file into a DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv('soil_ph_data.csv')

# Calculate basic statistics
mean_ph = df['pH'].mean()
median_ph = df['pH'].median()
mode_ph = df['pH'].mode()[0]

# Plot histogram
plt.hist(df['pH'], bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Soil pH')
plt.xlabel('pH')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

# Identify outliers
q1 = df['pH'].quantile(0.25)
q3 = df['pH'].quantile(0.75)
iqr = q3 - q1
lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
upper_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
outliers = df[(df['pH'] < lower_bound) | (df['pH'] > upper_bound)]
